description.value: Station BBQ is a Southern-style smokehouse established in 2013 in Vernon, BC, built on the philosophy of cooking meats low and slow over real wood with no shortcuts. Brisket, pork ribs, pulled pork, and sausage are served 'naked' with house-made sauces on the side, and the kitchen also offers catering for events of all sizes. Hungry cyclists can dine in with table reservations or order takeout online, including BBQ by the pound to take on the road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates all OSM contact fields (phone 250-260-6677, address #101 3131 29th Street, email info@stationbbq.com). The website confirms active operation with an online ordering system, a dedicated gluten-free menu page listing 14 GF items, and explicit takeout ordering options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM address field is blank; full address (#101, 3131 29th Street, Vernon, BC V1T 5A8) is sourced from the website and should be added to OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant in Vernon with active website, online ordering, and catering services — a solid stop for touring cyclists seeking a substantial hot meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dedicated /gluten-free page lists 14 GF-labelled items across appetizers, mains, sides, and takeout categories. No explicit vegetarian or vegan options noted
